text:
mira: Quick UX sync — chart annotations are stacking and the legend overlaps the plot on narrow widths. Also thinking about ARIA for annotation markers. Thoughts? ben: Saw it — on mobile the legend wraps into the plot area. We could float the legend above the canvas at <=480px or collapse it into a chevron/dropdown. Collapse saves vertical space. :thinking: sofia: Prefer collapsing into a 3-dot menu with counts. When collapsed, include concise alt text for each legend item (e.g., "Errors — red, 3 annotations"). Don't hide information. jamal: For annotation ordering, pin the 'active' annotation to the top (hover/selected), then list others by severity, not by timestamp. Active-first makes interactions predictable. :thumbsup: mira: Agreed. Also for screen readers we should announce new annotations via a polite live region, e.g., aria-live="polite" on the annotation list so SR users know "Annotation: Spike at 12:34, value 1200" when created. ben: Example I threw together: ```
  • Spike near 12:34 — 1200 req/s
``` Also ensure focus moves to the annotation panel when a new one is created if the user has it open. sofia: Color contrast note — our red marker is failing AA at small sizes. Either increase stroke width (2px) or shift hue to darker magenta (#9B1F4A) so markers are visible against the grid. jamal: Smoothing toggle: when enabled, show a small badge in the legend like "smoothed" (tooltip: "Savitzky-Golay smoothing applied") and make the toggle keyboard accessible (role="switch", tabindex="0"). mira: Outlier handling options: (A) clip out-of-range points to axis edge and show a plus-edge marker with a tooltip; (B) draw full point off-chart (could mislead y-scale). Which is less confusing? ben: Vote for A — clip + edge marker. Drawing off-chart skews perception of axis range. :chart_with_upwards_trend: sofia: Also add responsive unit rules: show "RPS" at <400px but keep full "requests per second" in the legend tooltip and aria-label for screen readers. jamal: Action items: 1) design to mock collapsed legend + chevron; 2) dev: add aria-live for annotations + focus behavior; 3) design/dev: increase marker contrast and stroke; 4) PM/product to decide clip vs full point. mira: I'll push a quick mock later today and tag @product for the outlier decision. Thanks! :raised_hands:
